package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type submitRepositoryFake struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance       domain.TaskInstance
	intent         domain.SubmitIntent
	submission     domain.Submission
	order          *[]string
	failSaveStatus string
	commits        int
}

type submitIDGenerator struct{ ids []string }

func (generator *submitIDGenerator) next() string {
	value := generator.ids[0]
	generator.ids = generator.ids[1:]
	return value
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) GetInstance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if studentID != repository.instance.StudentID || instanceID != repository.instance.ID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.instance, nil
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) GetIntent(_ context.Context, taskInstanceID, idempotencyKey string) (domain.SubmitIntent, error) {
	if repository.intent.TaskInstanceID == taskInstanceID && repository.intent.IdempotencyKey == idempotencyKey {
		return repository.intent, nil
	}
	return domain.SubmitIntent{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) CreateOrLoadIntent(_ context.Context, intent domain.SubmitIntent) (domain.SubmitIntent, bool, error) {
	*repository.order = append(*repository.order, "intent")
	repository.intent = intent
	return intent, true, nil
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) SaveIntent(_ context.Context, intent domain.SubmitIntent) error {
	*repository.order = append(*repository.order, "save-intent")
	if intent.Status == repository.failSaveStatus {
		repository.failSaveStatus = ""
		return errors.New("process stopped after provider receipt before intent save")
	}
	repository.intent = intent
	return nil
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) CommitIntent(_ context.Context, intent domain.SubmitIntent, submission domain.Submission, _ domain.ValidationRun) error {
	*repository.order = append(*repository.order, "commit")
	repository.intent, repository.submission = intent, submission
	repository.commits++
	return nil
}

func (repository *submitRepositoryFake) GetSubmission(_ context.Context, taskInstanceID, submissionID string) (domain.Submission, error) {
	if repository.submission.TaskInstanceID == taskInstanceID && repository.submission.ID == submissionID {
		return repository.submission, nil
	}
	return domain.Submission{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}

type submitWorkspaceFake struct {
	order   *[]string
	ref     domain.SnapshotRef
	locks   []ports.LockWorkspaceWrites
	freezes []ports.FreezeSnapshot
}

func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) CreateOrResumeWorkspace(context.Context, ports.CreateWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	panic("not used")
}
func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) FreezeSnapshot(_ context.Context, input ports.FreezeSnapshot) (domain.SnapshotRef, error) {
	*workspace.order = append(*workspace.order, "freeze")
	workspace.freezes = append(workspace.freezes, input)
	return workspace.ref, nil
}
func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) ReadPinnedSnapshot(_ context.Context, ref domain.SnapshotRef) (ports.WorkspaceSnapshot, error) {
	*workspace.order = append(*workspace.order, "read")
	return ports.WorkspaceSnapshot{Ref: ref, Files: []domain.WorkspaceFile{{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main"}}}, nil
}
func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) LockWrites(_ context.Context, input ports.LockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	*workspace.order = append(*workspace.order, "lock")
	workspace.locks = append(workspace.locks, input)
	return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{LockID: input.RequestID, FenceEpoch: 7}, nil
}
func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) UnlockWrites(context.Context, ports.UnlockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	panic("not used")
}
func (workspace *submitWorkspaceFake) RestoreWorkspace(context.Context, ports.RestoreWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	panic("not used")
}

func TestSubmitPersistsIntentBeforeLockFreezeAndPinnedRead(t *testing.T) {
	order := []string{}
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 1, 2, 3, 0, time.UTC)
	instance := submitReadyInstance()
	ref := domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: "sandbox-1", SnapshotID: "snapshot-1", GenerationID: "generation-1", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
	repository := &submitRepositoryFake{instance: instance, order: &order}
	workspace := &submitWorkspaceFake{order: &order, ref: ref}
	ids := &submitIDGenerator{ids: []string{"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, Now: func() time.Time { return now }, NewID: ids.next}
	command := domain.SubmitCommand{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
		IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", Scope: "FINAL"}
	submission, status, err := runtime.Submit(context.Background(), command)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Submit failed: %v", err)
	}
	if status != 202 || submission.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating || submission.Snapshot != ref || len(submission.ValidationRuns) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected submit response: status=%d submission=%+v", status, submission)
	}
	wantOrder := []string{"intent", "lock", "save-intent", "freeze", "save-intent", "read", "commit"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(order, wantOrder) {
		t.Fatalf("side-effect order = %v, want %v", order, wantOrder)
	}
}

func TestSubmitRejectsNonNextMilestoneBeforeDurableIntent(t *testing.T) {
	order := []string{}
	instance := submitReadyInstance()
	instance.Steps = append(instance.Steps, domain.Step{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000013", Required: true, Status: "AVAILABLE"})
	repository := &submitRepositoryFake{instance: instance, order: &order}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository}
	command := domain.SubmitCommand{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
		IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", Scope: "MILESTONE", MilestoneID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014"}
	_, _, err := runtime.Submit(context.Background(), command)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("non-next milestone should conflict, got %v", err)
	}
	if len(order) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid command caused durable or external side effects: %v", order)
	}
}

func TestFinalSubmitAcceptsPreviouslyCheckpointedRequiredMilestone(t *testing.T) {
	order := []string{}
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 1, 2, 3, 0, time.UTC)
	instance := submitReadyInstance()
	instance.Steps[0].Status = "CHECKPOINTED"
	ref := domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: "sandbox-1", SnapshotID: "snapshot-1", GenerationID: "generation-1", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
	repository := &submitRepositoryFake{instance: instance, order: &order}
	workspace := &submitWorkspaceFake{order: &order, ref: ref}
	ids := &submitIDGenerator{ids: []string{"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, Now: func() time.Time { return now }, NewID: ids.next}
	command := domain.SubmitCommand{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
		IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", Scope: "FINAL"}
	if _, status, err := runtime.Submit(context.Background(), command); err != nil || status != 202 {
		t.Fatalf("final submit after checkpoint should be accepted: status=%d error=%v", status, err)
	}
}

func TestSubmitRecoversProviderReceiptBeforeIntentSaveAcrossRestart(t *testing.T) {
	for _, cut := range []struct {
		status          string
		persistedStatus string
		lockCalls       int
		freezeCalls     int
	}{
		{status: "LOCKED", persistedStatus: "INTENT", lockCalls: 2, freezeCalls: 1},
		{status: "FROZEN", persistedStatus: "LOCKED", lockCalls: 1, freezeCalls: 2},
	} {
		t.Run(cut.status, func(t *testing.T) {
			order := []string{}
			instance := submitReadyInstance()
			const submissionID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010"
			const runID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
			ref := domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID, SnapshotID: submissionID,
				GenerationID: "gen-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
			repository := &submitRepositoryFake{instance: instance, order: &order, failSaveStatus: cut.status}
			workspace := &submitWorkspaceFake{order: &order, ref: ref}
			ids := &submitIDGenerator{ids: []string{submissionID, runID}}
			command := domain.SubmitCommand{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
				IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", Scope: "FINAL"}
			first := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, NewID: ids.next}
			if _, status, err := first.Submit(context.Background(), command); err == nil || status != 503 {
				t.Fatalf("cut after %s: status=%d err=%v", cut.status, status, err)
			}
			if repository.intent.Status != cut.persistedStatus || repository.commits != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected durable state at cut: %+v commits=%d", repository.intent, repository.commits)
			}
			// A new Runtime has no process-local locks or ID-generator state. Its
			// only recovery inputs are the durable intent and provider receipts.
			restarted := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, NewID: func() string { t.Fatal("recovery generated a new identity"); return "" }}
			submission, status, err := restarted.Submit(context.Background(), command)
			if err != nil || status != 202 || submission.ID != submissionID || submission.Snapshot != ref ||
				len(submission.ValidationRuns) != 1 || submission.ValidationRuns[0].ID != runID || repository.commits != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("restart recovery: status=%d err=%v submission=%+v commits=%d", status, err, submission, repository.commits)
			}
			if len(workspace.locks) != cut.lockCalls || len(workspace.freezes) != cut.freezeCalls || repository.intent.WriteLockID != submissionID {
				t.Fatalf("receipt reuse: locks=%+v freezes=%+v intent=%+v", workspace.locks, workspace.freezes, repository.intent)
			}
			for _, request := range workspace.locks {
				if request.RequestID != submissionID || request.SubmissionID != submissionID || request.Mode != "TEMPORARY" {
					t.Fatalf("unstable lock identity: %+v", request)
				}
			}
			for _, request := range workspace.freezes {
				if request.SubmissionID != submissionID || request.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID || request.SandboxID != ref.SandboxID {
					t.Fatalf("unstable freeze identity: %+v", request)
				}
			}
			before := len(order)
			replayed, _, err := restarted.Submit(context.Background(), command)
			if err != nil || replayed.ID != submission.ID || len(order) != before || repository.commits != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("committed replay changed result or repeated effects: %+v err=%v", replayed, err)
			}
			changed := command
			changed.Scope, changed.MilestoneID = "MILESTONE", instance.Steps[0].ID
			if _, status, err := restarted.Submit(context.Background(), changed); status != 409 || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrIdempotency) || len(order) != before {
				t.Fatalf("changed payload replay: status=%d err=%v effects=%v", status, err, order[before:])
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestSubmitPendingIntentDoesNotExecuteAfterCancellationOrAbort(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scenario := range []string{"cancelled", "aborted"} {
		t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
			order := []string{}
			instance := submitReadyInstance()
			command := domain.SubmitCommand{StudentID: instance.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: instance.ID,
				IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", Scope: "FINAL"}
			digest, err := domain.CommandDigest(command)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			intent := domain.SubmitIntent{TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, StudentID: instance.StudentID, IdempotencyKey: command.IdempotencyKey,
				CommandDigest: digest, SubmissionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", ValidationRunID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012",
				Scope: "FINAL", Status: "LOCKED", WriteLockID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010", FenceEpoch: 7}
			if scenario == "cancelled" {
				instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceCancelled
			} else {
				intent.Status = "ABORTED"
			}
			repository := &submitRepositoryFake{instance: instance, intent: intent, order: &order}
			workspace := &submitWorkspaceFake{order: &order, ref: domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: instance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID,
				SnapshotID: intent.SubmissionID, GenerationID: "gen-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
				WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace}
			if _, status, err := runtime.Submit(context.Background(), command); status != 409 || !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("closed intent must conflict: status=%d err=%v", status, err)
			}
			if len(order) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("closed intent executed provider or persistence effects: %v", order)
			}
		})
	}
}

func submitReadyInstance() domain.TaskInstance {
	studentID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
	instanceID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
	revisionID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"
	stepID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005"
	return domain.TaskInstance{ID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, TaskRevisionID: revisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		Status:             domain.TaskInstanceInProgress, LearningActionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
		WorkspaceBinding: domain.WorkspaceBinding{SandboxID: "sandbox-1", Available: true},
		Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: stepID, Required: true, Status: "PASSED", Targets: []domain.Target{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}},
			ValidationContract: json.RawMessage(`{"schema":"contract.v1"}`), EvaluationAssets: domain.EvaluationAssets{TestSuiteRef: "suite://one"},
			RuntimeProfile: json.RawMessage(`{"code_structure_type_code":"HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT","compose_config":{}}`)}},
		RevisionEnvelope: domain.RevisionEnvelope{RuntimeContext: json.RawMessage(`{}`)},
		StartedAt:        time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
}
